papers.title: Selective laser melting of AlSi10Mg alloy: influence of heat treatment condition on mechanical properties and microstructure

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究AlSi10Mg合金的SLM工艺与热处理，未涉及生物医学植入物、多孔结构或应力遮挡，与用户方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies SLM of AlSi10Mg for non-biomedical applications; it does not address porous implant design, stress shielding, fatigue, osseointegration, or any biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热处理对SLM成型AlSi10Mg合金力学性能与微观组织的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用不同热处理工艺对SLM试样进行后处理，并进行力学测试与显微分析。
summary_zh.result: 热处理显著改变合金的强度、硬度和微观组织形貌。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸、硬度测试及SEM观察验证性能与组织变化。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of heat treatment on the mechanical properties and microstructure of AlSi10Mg alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Samples were post-processed with various heat treatments and characterized by mechanical testing and microscopy.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment significantly affected tensile strength, hardness, and microstructural features.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical tests (tensile, hardness) and microstructural analysis (SEM, optical microscopy).

papers.title: Bioprinting
papers.abstract: 3D bioprinting is a potential technology for fabricating kidney and tracheal grafts since the matching donors is insufficient for many patients on demand. However, cell damage occurs due to variety factors during bioprinting process and is considered as a possible barrier for broad applications of delicate cells 3D bioprinting. Therefore, Cell viability is very challenging task in 3D bioprinting. The prime objective of current study is to explore effect of printing frequency on cell viability during printing process by a homemade Pneumatic Microdrop-on-Demand (PMOD) platform. Thus Human Embryonic Kidney 293 Cells (HEK293Cs) with diameter 15~20 μm and Human Bronchial Epithelial Cells (HBECs) with diameter 50~70 μm are printed to different sample tubes at frequencies of 10~70 Hz. Non-ejected cell suspension is categorized as control group. Then 7-AAD dye and flow cytometry method are utilized to evaluate the cell viability. It is found that the relative viabilities of HEK293Cs and HBECs are (0.990 ± 0.006) and (0.996 ± 0.014) respectively. Hence, it is concluded that the printing frequency has no significant effect on cell viability and PMOD cell printer reaches high cell viability due to the low shear stress during cell printing process along with no moving component in the bioink-filled chamber.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究打印频率对细胞活性的影响，但未涉及任何人工智能或机器学习方法，与AI生物打印方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it is a purely experimental study on cell viability without any computational modeling or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究打印频率对生物打印过程中细胞活性的影响
summary_zh.method: 利用PMOD平台在不同频率下打印HEK293细胞和HBEC细胞，用7-AAD和流式细胞术评估活性
summary_zh.result: 打印频率对细胞活性无显著影响，PMOD打印机实现高细胞活性
summary_zh.validation: 通过流式细胞术量化细胞活性并与对照组比较

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of printing frequency on cell viability during the bioprinting process to address concerns about cell damage.
summary_en.method: HEK293 and HBEC cells were printed at frequencies ranging from 10 to 70 Hz using a homemade pneumatic microdrop-on-demand platform, and cell viability was assessed via 7-AAD staining and flow cytometry.
summary_en.result: Printing frequency showed no significant effect on cell viability, with relative viabilities of 0.990 ± 0.006 for HEK293 cells and 0.996 ± 0.014 for HBEC cells.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed by comparing viability of printed cells to non-ejected cell suspension control using flow cytometry.

papers.title: Structure and porosity of titanium scaffolds manufactured by selective laser melting
papers.abstract: The article presents the results of experimental and numerical studies of titanium scaffolds for cell cultures. In structural studies using scanning microscopy, the influence of incremental technology and technological process parameters on the shape and the size of the designed pores was analyzed. The designed constructions of various sizes and pore shapes were verified for strength using numerical simulations by the finite element method (FEM).

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及选择性激光熔化钛支架的孔隙结构和强度模拟，但与应力屏蔽、疲劳或骨整合无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: No stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration characterization, and no mechanical testing beyond FEM simulation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选择性激光熔化钛支架的结构和孔隙度对强度的影响
summary_zh.method: 利用扫描电镜和有限元模拟分析工艺参数对孔隙形态和强度的影响
summary_zh.result: 工艺参数显著影响孔隙尺寸和形状，有限元模拟验证了支架的强度
summary_zh.validation: 通过扫描电镜实验和有限元数值模拟进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of selective laser melting process parameters on pore structure and mechanical strength of titanium scaffolds.
summary_en.method: Scanning electron microscopy and finite element method simulations were used to analyze pore morphology and strength.
summary_en.result: Process parameters significantly affect pore size and shape, and FEM simulations validated scaffold strength.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through experimental SEM characterization and numerical FEM simulations.

papers.title: Influence of surface modifications of a nanostructured implant on osseointegration capacity - preliminary
papers.abstract: In response to the need for implant materials characterized by high biocompatibility a new type of nanostructured Ti6Al7Nb implants for osseous tissue regeneration have been fabricated. The nanostructured cylindrical implants were manufactured in accordance with 3D CAD data using the Selective Laser Melting (SLM) method. Implants were subjected to chemical polishing using a mixture of nitric acid and fluoride (test group) as well as cleaned in distilled water and isopropyl alcohol (control group). The structural and morphological properties of the obtained samples were determined by using XRD (X-ray powder diffraction), TEM (transmission electron microscopy) and SEM (scanning electron microscopy) techniques. The particle size was verified and calculated by Rietveld method to be in the range of 25-90 nm. In the present study, experimental in vivo tests concerning implants fabricated from a nanostructured Ti6Al7Nb alloy, which may substitute bone tissue, were discussed in detail. The control group and test group were used in the study. The animal model was New Zealand rabbit. The implants were implanted into skull fornix and observed after 1, 2 and 3 months. The results of macroscopic and microscopic analysis proved better osseointegration of chemically modified implants.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接涉及AM生物医学植入物的表面改性及骨整合，但缺少应力屏蔽、疲劳和机械测试分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not include any mechanical testing or fatigue analysis, and does not address stress shielding or stiffness matching via porous structures.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发高生物相容性的纳米结构Ti6Al7Nb植入物以促进骨组织再生。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制造纳米结构圆柱植入物，并进行化学抛光与体内植入实验。
summary_zh.result: 化学改性植入物在兔子颅骨模型中表现出更好的骨整合效果。
summary_zh.validation: 采用新西兰兔体内植入实验，通过宏观和微观分析验证骨整合能力。

summary_en.motivation: To develop nanostructured Ti6Al7Nb implants with enhanced biocompatibility for bone tissue regeneration.
summary_en.method: Nanostructured cylindrical implants were fabricated by SLM and subjected to chemical polishing or cleaning, followed by in vivo implantation in rabbit skulls.
summary_en.result: Chemically modified implants showed superior osseointegration compared to controls after 1, 2, and 3 months.
summary_en.validation: In vivo animal experiments with macroscopic and microscopic analysis confirmed improved osseointegration of the surface-modified implants.
